tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description:
Full daily panchang for a date and place — computed by the same
    panchang-core engine the HinduCalendar Android app ships, so the values
    are identical to the app (not an approximation).

    Returns the five limbs at sunrise (tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vaar)
    each with its END TIME, p

tools.name: get_festival_dates
tools.description:
Exact dates of major Hindu festivals for any year, computed live by the
    same engine the HinduCalendar app uses — never guess a festival date,
    always use this.

    Covers the tithi-anchored festivals (Diwali, Holi, Krishna Janmashtami,
    Ganesh Chaturthi, Rama Navami, Maha Shivaratri, Raks

tools.name: get_muhurat_windows
tools.description:
Dated windows of the auspicious muhurta yogas and the observance periods —
    the "when are the vivah muhurats in 2026?" and "when is Chaturmas?" family.
    Computed live by panchang-core's MuhurtaFinder, the same engine behind the
    app's Muhurta Finder and the hinducalendar.app muhurat pages.

tools.name: get_birth_details
tools.description:
Return birth star (nakshatra), birth name syllable (naam akshar / pada),
    Chandra rashi (Moon sign), and Lagna rashi (ascendant sign) for a child
    born at the given time and location — all from the app's own engine, so
    they match the HinduCalendar app's kundali exactly.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_festival_dates" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_festival_dates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
